'''Dengar876 Capturing and Dealing with Droids''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dengar876]]
* '''Published:''' 22 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Deal Dengar876 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Dark Deal capturing Deck using bounty hunters and droids.

Note: This deck is only using cards Thru Coruscant

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Note: This deck is only Thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!

Start out by using your starting to pull East Platform, Executor, Bespin Cloud City, Carbonite Chamber, Port Town District and 2nd turn pull Bespin, 3rd Dark Deal, 4th Cloud city occ.

Start Out by controling your sites, and pulling cards. Wait for them to come and when they do capture them using bounties then throw them in security tower. If they don't come to your sites well obviusly start draining like crazy using dark deal! If they cancel Dark Deal by occupying 4 bespin locations they there should be a bunch of guy to go and capture.

Control Bespin with Executor, and another starship so you can draw destiny, Bespin: Cloud city with Stinger and Virago

If they have a space deck use 4-Lom, Guri and Xizor in their ships (4-loms is mist hunter).

Wed15-17 'Septoid' Droid is great for attrition, and you can use Incinerator to retrieve your droids for 2 force. If you can get Forced Servitude down and control that location, then for attrition you can forfet guri for up to 7 battle damage and retrieve it for 2 force using incinerator!

Throw Interrogation Array, Corporal Prescott on the Security Tower, then pull Aiiii! Aaa! Aggggggggg! after getting a bunch of captives.

Cloud City Incinerator is sweet, throw Guri, 4-Lom w/ Rifle, IG-88 w/ Gun, and EV-909 all down at that site, with EV-909 that is drain +4! Use Bane Malar or Aurra Sing there and then you can also draw battle destiny there!

Note: This deck is only Thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!
